name: Pronunciation
description: Underlines the words of your English dictation said with a German or Swedish accent feature (th, z, w and v, final voicing), with how to say them.

settings.label: Underline
settings.description: Which words get the wavy underline. A mark is sure when the model was at least 88% sure of the sound, otherwise not sure.

settings.label: Voice box (ssh)
settings.description: Where Say it right is made: a GPU machine you have ssh access to, such as root@ssh2.vast.ai. The first click installs Seed-VC there (minutes, once). Empty: no Say it right.

settings.label: Voice box port
settings.description: The box's ssh port; 0 is ssh's own default.

settings.label: Voice box key file
settings.description: The ssh private key file for the box; empty uses ssh's own.

settings.label: Your voice sample
settings.description: A wav of your voice, about 20 s of clean full-quality speech. Empty: your cleanest recent dictation, which prifly gives at 16 kHz, so the voice comes out less like yours.
